stem: How are the merchant in “The Dishonest Merchant” and the speaker in “Guilty” similar?

options.label: A
options.text: Both of them are disappointed in themselves for what they did.

options.label: B
options.text: Both of them are confused about why they have been punished.

options.label: C
options.text: Both of them try to blame others in order to get what they want.

options.label: D
options.text: Both of them are forced to keep their promises.
